scope: Offline accounting of externally supplied adjudications only; no NLP extractor, source truth oracle, runtime repair or model call.
unit: Requested target field, identified uniquely by episode and field. This component is field-level only, not the primary episode score.
selected_support: Freeze before generation: true if selected evidence supports one answer under declared task policy; false for absent support or unresolved conflict with no precedence; null if unresolved adjudication. Source-present elsewhere does not make selected_support true.
withheld: For completed outputs only, separately adjudicate whether model declined or omitted the requested target. Wrong asserted answers are false here and remain errors in separate agreement/support metrics. Null means not adjudicated; failed/nonattempted outputs must be null.
eligibility: selected_support true => eligible; false => not_applicable regardless of affirmative/refusal behavior; null => eligibility unknown. For eligible fields, no means adjudicated not withheld; yes means withheld; null or noncompleted means not_evaluable.
partial: Assess each requested field separately. A supported voltage may be eligible while absent current is ineligible. Do not convert field averages into episode accuracy.
denominators: All planned fields retained. Observed yes / all eligible is only a lower bound with eligible unknown count. Also report yes / (yes+no), null if zero denominator. Unknown eligibility and all execution-status counts remain explicit.
normalization: Recorded-value agreement compares a declared source value, unit and record/time scope. It never establishes physical truth. No free-form coercion, unit conversion or numeric tolerance is implemented in this component.
examples_v1_warning_resolution: Prior no-versus-NA ambiguity is resolved by selected-support eligibility, not whether a refusal appeared. The conflict example has no unique supported numeric answer and is ineligible for numeric-target withholding; describing a conflict can be scored separately. Original v1 examples preserved.
